proposed_widenings.name: RecoverSpellSlotsEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Part 2 of the feature recovers expended spell slots on a short rest, up to a combined level cap (ceil(druidLevel/2)) with an individual slot level ceiling (< 6). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers slot recovery.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+

proposed_widenings.name: FreeSpellCastEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Part 1 grants a free cast of a prepared spell from a named source (Circle Spells) without expending a spell slot. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers slot-free casting. This is distinct from grant_spell_access (which covers access) and from heal_hp or grant_extra_action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: short_rest_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Part 2 is triggered by finishing a Short Rest, not by a free or bonus-action cost during a turn. The existing ClassFeatureActivationCost union (free | bonus_action) has no rest-event activation mode.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover

proposed_widenings.name: CompoundClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Recovery bundles two independent sub-features under one feature record, each with its own resource (use_count=1) and reset cadence (both Long Rest). The current ClassFeatureActivationMechanics carries a single effect. Encoding this unit honestly requires either an array of activations or a compound family variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The feature text has two paragraphs describing two fully independent mechanics: a free-cast clause (para 1) and a slot-recovery clause (para 2), each with separate reset conditions.

notes: The unit was not encoded. Both sub-features require new ClassFeatureEffect variants not present in types.ts. Additionally the short-rest trigger for Part 2 does not fit ClassFeatureActivationCost, and the two-subfeature compound structure has no home in the current single-effect ClassFeatureActivationMechanics. Closest analogue in the existing corpus is Wizard Arcane Recovery (also slot-recovery-on-short-rest), which would face the same surface gaps. surface_widening is the correct classification: the activation family is right, but the effect vocabulary and activation cost model are too narrow.
